entities.name: Mladen Dražetin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mladen Dražetin was a Serbian economist, theatrical creator, poet, writer and philosopher. His father Rada was a courier in the Local Community Office in Mošorin, while his mother Vukica was from Sombor. He left behind works of poetry, prose, drama and philosophy. He was the creator of the Correspondence Theatre, a specific type of theater organization and play, which he conceived and organized in 1974.
